subject: Renewal + Support Elevation — HorizonPay renewal / premium SLA discussion
messages:
From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@horizonpay.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@horizonpay.com>
Date: 2029-10-20 09:12 AM -0700
Subject: HorizonPay renewal / support uplift

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you’re well — HorizonPay’s renewal is coming up (Dec 15). We’ve seen steady growth and expect a 2.5x monthly token volume over the next 12 months. Procurement asked us to explore a premium support path: lower latency SLOs (p95 120ms -> 60ms), prioritized oncall routing, and a defined on-call escalation SLA.

Can Redwood provide a clear uplift option (pricing, operational onramp timeline, and any burst capacity guarantees)? Procurement attached an RFP and a rough traffic forecast.

Primary ask: a concrete renewal offer we can take to legal/procurement by Nov 15.

Thanks — happy to jump on a call next week.

— Alyssa
Alyssa Turner | Head of Platform Services, HorizonPay

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@horizonpay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@horizonpay.com>
Date: 2029-10-20 11:03 AM -0700
Subject: Re: HorizonPay renewal / support uplift

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the details and the forecast.

We can absolutely support a premium SLA path with the latency targets you called out. High level:
- Dedicated priority queueing and regional reserved capacity for expected peak windows.
- p95 target of 60ms for the agreed model tier (we’ll propose a model pin list).
- 24/7 priority oncall with a 30-minute initial response target and documented escalation ladder.
- Optional burst reservation for seasonal spikes (configurable in months).

Action items:
1) I’ll put together an uplift proposal with pricing and a 30/60/90 day onramp plan.
2) Can you confirm whether HorizonPay needs private deployment (VPC) or if Hosted with Dedicated capacity is acceptable?
3) Let’s schedule a 45-minute alignment call — I’m available Wed 10/24 8–11am PT or Thu 10/25 1–4pm PT.

Attaching initial intake checklist — I’ll follow with the SLA appendix and a draft MAP (mutual action plan) by next Wednesday.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@horizonpay.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@horizonpay.com>
Date: 2029-10-20 12:26 PM -0700
Subject: Re: HorizonPay renewal / support uplift

Thanks Kimberly — Hosted + Dedicated capacity is preferred for now (we want to avoid on-prem complexity this renewal). Wed 10/24 9:30am PT works.

I’ve attached the RFP and a traffic export for the last 6 months. Procurement wants the pricing broken down (base usage, reserved capacity, premium support uplift, and optional burst credits). They also asked for a sample SLA appendix that shows remedies and credit calculations.

See you Wed.

— Alyssa

Attachments: HorizonPay_PROC_RFP.xlsx (xlsx), HorizonPay_Renewal_Request_2029.pdf (pdf)

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-10-21 08:15 AM -0700
Subject: RE: HorizonPay renewal / support uplift (pricing levers)

Kim / Ben — quick thoughts ahead of the call:

- Pricing levers we can move: commit tier (12/24/36 mo), premium support flat fee vs % uplift, burst-credit pools, SLA credit cap.
- Given the 2.5x forecast, recommend: 12-mo committed reserved capacity + quarterly review, premium support as a fixed monthly retainer (easier for procurement), and a 1.25x burst bucket priced at 40% of overage.
- We should offer a pilot month at the premium SLOs (reduced fee) to validate latency at their typical peak pattern.

I can own the pricing appendix and model cost impacts; Kimberly, want me looped on the call?

— Marissa
VP, Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@horizonpay.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@horizonpay.com>
Date: 2029-11-15 09:02 AM -0800
Subject: Re: HorizonPay renewal / support uplift — procurement redlines

Team,

Thanks for the call and the initial proposal. Procurement returned a draft with a few asks:
- They want the SLA credit formula clarified when we have multi-model fallbacks.
- Legal requested an explicit timeline for the onramp (dates, milestones) and a named escalation contact.
- They flagged availability of audit logs and retention for 13 months (compliance).

I’ve attached Procurement_Redlines.pdf with inline comments. Can you respond with a redlined SLA appendix and an updated MAP by Nov 26? Procurement will need the final commercial terms by Dec 2 to get internal approvals.

Procurement note: procurement@horizonpay.com is copied — they’ll coordinate legal.

Attachments: Procurement_Redlines.pdf (pdf)

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@horizonpay.com>, Procurement <procurement@horizonpay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-12-04 04:05 PM -0800
Subject: Re: HorizonPay renewal / support uplift — final SLA & MAP

Hi Alyssa / Procurement team,

Appreciate the redlines and patience. Attached: SLA_Appendix_Premium_v1.2.pdf and the final Mutual Action Plan (MAP). Key changes per your comments:

- Multi-model fallback: SLA credit will prorate by last successful model tier; credits capped at 10% monthly invoice with a two-step dispute window.
- Onramp timeline: we’ve provided milestone dates (kickoff 12/16, reserved capacity live 01/10, performance validation pilot 01/31).
- Named escalation: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.ai) — Director, Platform Ops — is the 24/7 escalation contact.
- Audit logs: 13-month retention documented; exportable logs and SOC2 evidence link included.

Commercial summary: 12-month committed reserved capacity + $30k/mo premium support retainer + optional burst-credit pool (pre-purchased). Pilot month at 50% of the retainer during Jan to prove latency under your peak patterns. Full details and line-item pricing are in the MAP link below.

Next steps:
1) Procurement: confirm acceptance of the MAP and SLA appendix by Dec 10 so we can get paperwork to Legal.
2) I’ll send the DocuSign when you confirm — expected signature window Dec 11–13 to meet your renewal date.

Links:
- Deal page: https://redwood.app/deals/HP-2029-Q4-regen
- Renewal draft & MAP: https://share.redwood.com/drive/HorizonPay/renewal-draft
- DocuSign (pending): https://docu.sign/horizonpay/renewal/12345

Attachments: SLA_Appendix_Premium_v1.2.pdf (pdf), HorizonPay_MAP_Final.xlsx (xlsx)

Best regards,
Kimberly Park\Senior Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0147
